alvrummet_reservat_ha.name: Approximate area of Älvrummet Nature Reserve
alvrummet_reservat_ha.note: The municipal visitor page states approximately 61 hectares, not the entire river landscape.

ryrbacken_reservat_ha.name: Approximate area of Ryrbäcken Nature Reserve
ryrbacken_reservat_ha.note: Approximately 43 hectares according to the municipality; south of the central model tile.

varvik_planerade_bostader.name: Planned homes in Vårvik
varvik_planerade_bostader.note: Approximately 1,600 homes in the 2026 consultation. A planning figure, not completed homes or a population forecast.

stridsberg_planerade_bostader.name: Planned apartments in Stridsberg
stridsberg_planerade_bostader.note: Approximately 1,000 apartments within Vårvik. Included in the total of 1,600; do not add the figures.

stridsberg_planomrade_ha.name: Stridsberg planning area
stridsberg_planomrade_ha.note: The planning area covers approximately 10 hectares and retained industrial buildings.

alvrummet_planerat_intrang_ha.name: Planned forest clearance in Älvrummet
alvrummet_planerat_intrang_ha.note: The September 2025 proposal involves about 5 hectares. This is proposed impact, not verified completed clearance.

skalsbo_kompensationsskog_ha.name: Forest proposed for compensation measures
skalsbo_kompensationsskog_ha.note: Approximately 26 hectares of forest. The final reserve may be larger; habitats are not automatically interchangeable hectare for hectare.

krontackning_riktvarde.name: Tree canopy planning benchmark
krontackning_riktvarde.note: The planning document gives a 30% neighbourhood canopy benchmark, not measured canopy across the city centre.

synliga_trad_riktvarde.name: Visible-tree planning benchmark
synliga_trad_riktvarde.note: The benchmark is three visible trees from home, school or workplace; an ambition, not a measured baseline.

hallbarhetsstrategi_teman.name: Themes in the sustainability strategy
hallbarhetsstrategi_teman.note: The strategy was adopted in 2025 and has eleven themes. The count does not measure achievement.

centrum_strategiska_vagval.name: Strategic directions for the city centre
centrum_strategiska_vagval.note: Climate neutrality, a digital centre, a visual and flexible city, and a young city.

forsta_slussled_ar.name: Opening year of the first completed lock route
forsta_slussled_ar.note: Historical anchor for industry, trade and urban development.

andra_slussled_ar.name: Opening year of the second lock route
andra_slussled_ar.note: The second route opened in 1844 after six years of construction.

nuvarande_slussled_ar.name: Opening year of the 1916 lock route
nuvarande_slussled_ar.note: A historical date, not a statement of current technical capacity.

slussomrade_byggnadsminne_ar.name: Year of state heritage designation
slussomrade_byggnadsminne_ar.note: The designation covers an ensemble of buildings, locks, bridges and installations.
